name: grafana-observability
description: Inspect administrator-approved Grafana evidence and draft incident briefs, handoffs, and postmortems.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate Grafana evidence and draft incident reviews.
interface.longDescription: Run five administrator-reviewed Grafana capability packs through bounded tools, then draft incident briefs, handoffs, and postmortems. Preserve uncertainty, source origin, and measured recovery criteria. Grafana and its datasources remain read-only; inputs are aliases, time windows, and opaque references. Pack runs retain plugin-owned local evidence state. Communication stays in the active task; no background monitoring, messaging, or remediation is provided.
defaultPrompt: Use $setup-grafana-observability to check the fixture profile and available packs.
Use $coordinate-grafana-incident to investigate this incident with my approved profile and draft a responder update.
Use $review-grafana-incident to draft a postmortem from the incident evidence and identify unresolved recovery criteria.
